fusions.name: Curled Charge
fusions.desc: You slam into the target for 15 damage, knocking it back 2.5 tiles and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Scale Spin
fusions.desc: Spins into every enemy within 2.5 tiles, dealing 4 damage to each.

fusions.name: Roll Away
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4s after you use it.

fusions.name: Curled Up
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, a shield worth 15% of your maximum health closes over you for 4 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
